items.title: Shakib ready to return to Bangladesh for court trial if given security
items.summary: The former Bangladesh captain hasn't returned to the country since May 2024

items.title: Bangladesh Emerging team reach tri-series final
items.summary: Bangladesh emerging team reached the final of the ongoing tri-series in South Africa after defeating University Sport South Africa (USSA) by seven wickets in their third match at Irene Country Club in Centurion on Friday.

items.title: No way back for Shakib: State Minister for Youth and Sports Aminul
items.summary: Bangladesh said on that Friday former star cricketer Shakib Al Hasan had no prospect of returning to play after he joined a media event with ousted former prime minister Sheikh Hasina, a convicted fugitive.

items.title: Shakib says he is ready to return home and face trial if given security
items.summary: Former Bangladesh captain Shakib Al Hasan, an ally of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, said he is ready to return from a two-year exile, face trial on charges including murder, and play a farewell series if the government guarantees his safety

items.title: Taijul adds to Bangladesh’s injury woes
items.summary: Bangladesh’s injury woes ahead of their two-Test series against Australia have taken another turn, with left-arm spinner Taijul Islam picking up a finger injury during the ongoing three-day warm-up game against Cricket Australia XI in Darwin.

items.title: Wyllie hundred and late wickets put Bangladesh under pressure
items.summary: The CA XI built a lead of 92 then Campbell Thompson claimed two wickets late in the day

items.title: Hasan shines, but CA XI take control
items.summary: Bangladesh’s bowling attack offered little reassurance ahead of their two-Test series against Australia as Cricket Australia XI took control of the ongoing three-day warm-up game against the Tigers in Darwin today.

items.title: Labuschagne feeling fresh ahead of Bangladesh Test series
items.summary: Labuschagne hasn't scored a Test century in more than three years despite some good contributions during Australia's 4-1 Ashes series triumph over England at the start of the year, but the former No.1 ranked Test batter believes he is not far away from regaining his touch and is targeting a strong showing during the upcoming home series with Bangladesh.

items.title: Mehidy Hasan Miraz century lifts Bangladesh after Corey Rocchiccioli takes six
items.summary: Sam Konstas and Campbell Kellaway fell cheaply against Bangladesh's new-ball attack

items.title: Neser suffers calf strain at training, but hopeful for South Africa tour
items.summary: Ashes hero was not selected in Australia's 13-man squad for the home two-Test series against Bangladesh, which starts next Thursday in Darwin
